description: A support agent forwards a customer's third unanswered billing complaint. Deliberately outside the current software.yaml policy pack (no 'customer_escalation' topic entry) — this scenario exercises the path where a case has no policy-derived required roles, so communication_health must be able to go critical on signals other than a stakeholder gap (here: repeated unanswered follow-ups from the customer).

trigger.subject: Re: Re: Re: Still being double-charged
trigger.body: This is my third email about this. I was charged twice again this month and still haven't heard back. I need this resolved or I'm cancelling.
